build_imrenormalize_tensor: build a python module to re-normalize a PyTorch tensor image from one normalization config to another
build_imrenormalize_ndarray: build a python module to re-normalize a numpy array image from one normalization config to another
test_imrenormalize: test the imrenormalize function by converting an image between two different normalization configurations
refactor_imrenormalize: refactor the imrenormalize function to support batched tensor images with shape N,C,H,W
summarize_imrenormalize: summarize the imrenormalize function that denormalizes then re-normalizes images using mmcv utilities
